symptom: ako/mxcli#886 (rehearsal 2 R1/D1): `create or modify microflow` treated an equivalent respelling as a change wherever the stored flow held a merge that joins nothing (so the built comparison could not decide): `AND` where the stored expression is `and`, a create/change member list over several lines where the stored one is on one line, `declare $X Long` where the flow stores Integer/Long. mdl 1 refused on every run inside a loop ("the Loop … changes inside its body"), and outside one the loop and the `if` after it were re-spliced on every run under both dialects ("spliced: 1 replaced, 1 dropped"), moving every later node +1440 px per run in formula1.
cause: The statement diff compared expressions as trees and SourceExpr text with only TrimSpace: the visitor keeps an expression slot's trailing whitespace (`false\n      ` before `)`), wraps text with `!=` in a SourceExpr that keeps `AND`, and describe prints the stored text one way. sameBuiltFlow compared expression strings byte for byte. ast.TypeLong and TypeInteger differ in the AST but the microflow writer stores both as DataTypes$IntegerType.
fix: mendixexpr.Canonical (whitespace between tokens dropped except between two words or two operator chars, keywords lower-cased unless a name, string literals verbatim); matchValue compares any ast.Expression pair and SourceExpr.Source by it (falling back to the tree for an XPath node the renderer cannot spell) and folds Long into Integer; sameBuiltFlow compares the model's expression fields (expressionFields) by it.
insight: The phantom only surfaced where the built comparison could not take over (a stray merge), so a flow created from the same text never showed it — the twice-exec test must store the flow from a DIFFERENT spelling than the one it re-runs. A multi-statement run that pairs a loop with a neighbour bypasses the loop-body refusal and rebuilds the loop, which is where the per-run drift came from: fix the phantom, then assert unchanged nodes keep their RelativeMiddlePoint in the real-change control.
